subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word opposite in meaning (ANTONYM) to the underlined word in the given sentence.

Human life is __transient__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**transient**" means temporary or not lasting.
 
• An antonym is a word that has the opposite meaning of another word.
 
• The opposite of "**transient**" is "**permanent**", which means lasting or intended to last indefinitely.
 
• Thus, "**permanent**" is the most appropriate word opposite in meaning to "**transient**".

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Human life is **transient.**"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Thrifty** – This means using money and other resources carefully and not wastefully. It is not related to the concept of time or permanence.
 
• **Timid** – This means showing a lack of courage or confidence. It does not relate to the temporary or permanent nature of something.
 
• **Tranquil** – This means calm and peaceful. It is not related to the duration or permanence of something.
